运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

targets 为 [[-100,-100,4,5,6],[-100,-100,8,6,-100]]，有效目标数为 5；两种归约方法一致。

python 20_tokenizer-autoregressive_demo.py环境配置

构造回答区监督，并核对五个有效目标

20_tokenizer-autoregressive_demo.py
# [1] 人工词表仅用于展示监督对齐，不替代真实模型 Tokenizerimport torchfrom torch import nnfrom torch.nn import functional as Ffrom torch.nn.utils.rnn import pad_sequencetorch.manual_seed(37)vocab = {"<pad>":0, "<bos>":1, "任务":2, "抓取":3,         "红":4, "杯":5, "<eos>":6, "蓝":7, "块":8}texts = ["<bos> 任务 抓取 红 杯 <eos>", "<bos> 任务 蓝 块 <eos>"]rows = [torch.tensor([vocab[t] for t in text.split()]) for text in texts]input_ids = pad_sequence(rows, batch_first=True, padding_value=0)valid = input_ids != vocab["<pad>"]labels = input_ids.clone()labels[:, :3] = -100  # 本例前 3 个 token 是 promptlabels[~valid] = -100 # [2] 小型因果模型：保持原位置，先产生每个位置的 logitsB, T = input_ids.shapeembedding = nn.Embedding(len(vocab), 12, padding_idx=0)position = nn.Embedding(T, 12)block = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(12, 3, 24, dropout=0.0, batch_first=True)head = nn.Linear(12, len(vocab))hidden = embedding(input_ids) + position(torch.arange(T))[None]blocked = torch.ones(T, T, dtype=torch.bool).triu(1)hidden = block(hidden, src_mask=blocked, src_key_padding_mask=~valid)logits = head(hidden) # [3] 自写的 loss 明确只移位一次predictions = logits[:, :-1].contiguous()targets = labels[:, 1:].contiguous()token_losses = F.cross_entropy(    predictions.reshape(-1, len(vocab)), targets.reshape(-1),    ignore_index=-100, reduction="none")count = (targets != -100).sum()loss = token_losses.sum() / countreference = F.cross_entropy(predictions.reshape(-1, len(vocab)),                            targets.reshape(-1), ignore_index=-100)torch.testing.assert_close(loss, reference)assert count.item() == 5loss.backward()assert embedding.weight.grad is not Noneprint("移位后目标:", targets.tolist())print("有效目标数:", count.item(), "loss:", round(loss.item(), 4))print("prompt / EOS / Padding 与移位检查通过")
